text: {"assertions":["A loss divergence problem was identified in ml/train/loop.py where the loss curve turned upward and never returned","The loss divergence issue only occurred for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was being shared across multiple function calls","The fix involved changing the default argument to empty and rebuilding the value for each call, implemented in PR #2157 on branch fix/loss-divergence-1","The bug was reproducible by training two epochs on the small split","After the fix was applied, the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 80 consecutive days of testing"]}
